apps.name: Purrch
apps.tagline: A cat that lives in your notch.
apps.description: Water reminders, a focus timer, to-dos, music with lyrics and a file shelf, all tucked into a little pill at the top of your screen. Runs locally; the only network call is the lyrics lookup.

apps.name: Messapp
apps.tagline: Chat, calls and servers for the group.
apps.description: Realtime messaging with encrypted DMs, voice and video calls, servers and media. Use it in the browser, or install it on Windows or Android.

apps.name: Convallaria
apps.tagline: A cozy farming RPG where death enriches the soil.
apps.description: Farm, fight and die: each death advances the world a day and leaves something behind for the next character. A prototype that runs in your browser.

apps.name: Chimaera
apps.tagline: A game launcher with friends built in.
apps.description: Library, downloads, cloud save backups to Google Drive and a Friends tab that talks to Messapp.

apps.name: Nyxplorer
apps.tagline: A modern file manager for Windows.
apps.description: A file manager based on Files by the Files Community.

apps.name: Teyvault
apps.description: Daily check-in, a wish tracker with pity and 50/50 stats, builds and a searchable wiki.

apps.name: BRHP-MSAM
apps.description: Barangay Health Workers profile residents offline, record health checks and immunizations, and log supply releases. Records sync to a central backend for the health offices.
